data.headline: For Lenovo - Product & Sales Operations Manager | BI, Forecasting & Performance Optimization
data.about: Results-driven Operations and Sales Strategy Leader with 12+ years of experience transforming complex business data into actionable strategies that drive growth, efficiency, and operational excellence. Proven success in leading product and sales operations for global technology brands including Lenovo, Zebronics, and Intex, where data-driven insights, forecasting models, and performance analytics have been leveraged to optimize pricing, supply planning, and e-commerce sales performance. Expert in business intelligence, Power BI dashboards, sales analytics, and cross-functional leadership, with a strong ability to translate raw data into strategic decisions that influence executive planning and market competitiveness. Recognized for building scalable reporting frameworks, improving operational workflows, and enabling high-performing teams through collaborative leadership and continuous improvement. Passionate about using analytics, automation, and strategic planning to unlock business value, enhance customer outcomes, and drive sustainable growth in fast-paced technology environments.

description.text:
Lenovo India Pvt. Ltd

• Optimized product pricing operations by executing backend SKU-level pricing updates, ensuring accurate and timely integration of promotional offers within internal systems. 

• Designed strategic forecasting and supply planning frameworks to improve promotional readiness and maximize campaign effectiveness. 

• Led cross-functional collaboration across sales, supply chain, and product teams to streamline operations and improve delivery efficiency. 

• Built executive-level dashboards and scalable BI frameworks (Power BI/Excel) to enable data-driven QBR discussions and strategic decision-making. 

• Managed and mentored a team of 2 members, driving operational accuracy, process adherence, and timely execution of backend product and pricing updates.

Lenovo India Pvt. Ltd

• E-Commerce Operations Management: Directed end-to-end e-tail operations including sales forecasting, weekly inventory planning, order flow monitoring, and performance tracking across multiple online marketplaces to ensure seamless sales and backend coordination. 

• Business Intelligence & Data Analytics: Delivered actionable insights by analyzing sales, supply chain, and financial datasets to support strategic decision-making and improve operational efficiency. 

• Dashboarding & Reporting Automation: Designed and maintained dynamic Power BI and advanced Excel dashboards, enabling leadership with real-time visibility into sales performance, inventory trends, and key operational metrics. 

• Market & Competitive Intelligence: Conducted Total Addressable Market (TAM) analysis and validated market share using IDC and GfK industry data to support strategic planning and identify growth opportunities. 

• Quarterly Business Review (QBR) Support: Prepared comprehensive performance reports and data-driven insights for leadership reviews, enabling informed strategic discussions and planning. 

• E-Commerce Listing & Pricing Governance: Coordinated with online sales and marketplace teams to ensure accurate product listings, pricing updates, promotional alignment, and catalog optimization across platforms. 

• Sales & Performance Reporting Optimization: Streamlined reporting frameworks and automated data workflows to improve reporting accuracy, reduce manual effort, and enhance data accessibility for stakeholders.

description.text:
Lenovo India Pvt. Ltd

• Designed and implemented key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure business performance and improve decision-making effectiveness.

• Led cross-functional initiatives to streamline operational processes, driving improvements in efficiency and workflow optimization.

• Analyzed sales and market data to identify growth opportunities and support strategic planning for successful product launches. 

• Leveraged data analytics and performance insights to guide business strategies and enhance operational outcomes. 

• Delivered actionable insights through data analysis, enabling leadership to make informed, data-driven business decisions.

• Led and mentored sales operations teams, improving workflow efficiency and ensuring timely execution of operational tasks. 

• Leveraged advanced Excel analytics (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) to analyze product-wise and branch-wise sales performance, enabling better business visibility. 

• Converted complex data into actionable insights, supporting sales teams in executing targeted strategies and improving decision making. 

• Designed and implemented operational improvement strategies to enhance team productivity, process efficiency, and sales performance.

• Data Intelligence & Reporting: Consolidated and analyzed multi-source business data to deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports across sales and operational functions. 

• Advanced Sales Analytics: Leveraged advanced Excel tools (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) to track, analyze, and visualize product level and branch-level sales performance. 

• Performance Dashboards: Designed and maintained dynamic daily sales dashboards enabling real-time monitoring of regional and SKU-level performance. 

• Business Insights & Strategy Support: Transformed complex datasets into actionable insights, empowering sales teams to implement data-driven strategies and improve performance. 

• Executive Reporting & Visualization: Developed intuitive dashboards and visual reports highlighting sales trends, performance gaps, and key business metrics for leadership decision-making. 

• Market & Competitive Intelligence: Conducted market trend analysis and competitive benchmarking to support sales planning and marketing strategy optimization. 

• Operational Coordination: Managed logistics, transportation, and travel arrangements for internal teams and business events to ensure seamless operational execution.

• Data Reporting & Business Insights: Compiled and analyzed multi-source data to deliver accurate weekly, monthly, and quarterly MIS reports, enabling leadership to make data-driven business decisions. 

• Sales Performance Monitoring: Tracked daily sales performance across products and branches, ensuring real-time visibility of branch productivity and overall sales health. 

• Strategic Sales Analysis: Analyzed sales trends, forecasts, and performance metrics to identify growth opportunities and recommend strategies to improve productivity. 

• MIS Team Leadership & Data Governance: Led the MIS team and conducted regular database audits to ensure high-quality reporting, data accuracy, and operational efficiency.
